faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Get answers to common questions about InSite Health System's equipment visibility solutions and implementation process.
faq.stillHaveQuestionsDesc: Our healthcare technology experts are here to help. Get personalized answers and learn how InSite can benefit your specific facility.

questions.question: How does InSite Health System track medical equipment?
questions.answer: InSite uses advanced IoT sensors and RFID technology to provide real-time location tracking of medical equipment throughout your facility. Our sensors are designed specifically for healthcare environments and integrate seamlessly with existing hospital infrastructure without disrupting daily operations.

questions.question: Is the system HIPAA compliant and secure?
questions.answer: Yes, InSite Health System is designed to be fully HIPAA compliant with end-to-end encryption, secure data transmission, and comprehensive audit trails. We implement industry-leading security measures to protect sensitive healthcare data.

questions.question: How long does implementation typically take?
questions.answer: Implementation varies based on facility size and complexity, but our pilot can be live in as few as 5 days. Our white-glove process includes site assessment, hardware installation, staff orientation, and system configuration — all handled by our team with minimal disruption to patient care.

questions.question: Can InSite integrate with our existing hospital management system?
questions.answer: Absolutely. InSite is designed to integrate with major hospital management systems including Epic, Cerner, Meditech, and others. Our API-first approach ensures seamless data flow between systems and maintains your existing workflows.

questions.question: What types of medical equipment can be tracked?
questions.answer: InSite can track virtually any medical equipment including wheelchairs, IV pumps, ventilators, patient monitors, beds, surgical instruments, and mobile diagnostic equipment. Our flexible sensor technology adapts to different equipment types and sizes.

questions.question: How much does InSite Health System cost?
questions.answer: Pricing is customized based on your facility size, number of assets, and specific requirements. We offer flexible subscription models with no upfront hardware costs. Contact us for a personalized quote and ROI analysis based on your needs.

questions.question: What kind of support and training do you provide?
questions.answer: We provide comprehensive 24/7 technical support, initial staff training, ongoing education programs, and dedicated customer success management. Our support team includes healthcare technology specialists who understand hospital operations.

questions.question: Can the system help with regulatory compliance and reporting?
questions.answer: Yes, InSite automatically generates compliance reports for Joint Commission, CMS, and other regulatory requirements. The system maintains detailed audit trails, equipment utilization reports, and maintenance scheduling to support your compliance efforts.

questions.question: What happens if equipment leaves the designated area?
questions.answer: InSite provides real-time alerts when equipment moves outside designated zones or leaves the facility. You can set custom alert rules, notification preferences, and automated workflows to ensure critical equipment stays where it's needed.

questions.question: How does InSite improve patient care and operational efficiency?
questions.answer: By reducing equipment search time — projected at 30–50% based on industry RTLS benchmarks — InSite allows staff to focus more on patient care. The system also optimizes equipment utilization, reduces equipment loss, improves maintenance scheduling, and provides data-driven insights for better resource allocation. All outcomes are measured transparently during the pilot.
